description.fun: Trapinch doesn't chase its food: it digs a cone-shaped pit in the desert sand and waits for prey to tumble in, then grabs it with jaws strong enough to crush boulders. It can go a week without food or water. Its head is so big for its body that if it flips onto its back, it can't get up again. It's based on an antlion larva.
description.guide: A Ground-type Pokémon based on an antlion larva, which traps prey in pits it digs in the desert. Its base Attack is higher than Vibrava's and equal to Flygon's. It evolves into Vibrava at level 35.
description.tagline: An antlion larva waiting at the bottom of a sand pit

description.fun: Vibrava's wings aren't fully grown, so it can't fly far yet, but it beats them to make ultrasonic waves that give people headaches and knock out its prey. It then spits stomach acid to melt its meal before eating, and it eats this way every day to help its wings grow. It's the only Pokémon that gains the Dragon type on evolving and can still evolve again.
description.guide: A Ground- and Dragon-type Pokémon based on an adult antlion, with underdeveloped wings that make strong vibrations. It lives in the desert. It evolves from Trapinch at level 35 and into Flygon at level 45.
description.tagline: A half-grown desert dragonfly that buzzes its prey unconscious

description.fun: Flygon's wings make a singing sound when it flaps them, earning it the name 'the Desert Spirit'. It whips up sandstorms to hide in, red lenses shield its eyes from the sand, and it even teams up with Krookodile to hunt and share the catch. Ken Sugimori said in 2015 that Flygon was meant to get a Mega Evolution in X and Y, but the idea was dropped when he hit artist's block.
description.guide: A Ground- and Dragon-type Pokémon based on an adult antlion with a dragon's build, living in the desert. It evolves from Vibrava at level 45 and is the final form of Trapinch.
description.tagline: The 'Desert Spirit', a dragon whose wings sing in the sandstorm
